name: list_pull_requests
summary: a repository's pull requests, a page at a time.

name: list_pull_requests_associated_with_commit
summary: the pull requests a commit belongs to, a page at a time.

name: list_pull_request_files
summary: the files a pull request changes, a page at a time.

name: list_pull_request_commits
summary: the commits on a pull request, a page at a time.

name: list_pull_request_requested_reviewers
summary: the users and teams a pull request's review is requested from.

name: list_pull_request_reviews
summary: the reviews of a pull request, a page at a time.

name: list_pull_request_review_comments
summary: the comments on a pull request's diff, a page at a time.

name: create_pull_request_review
summary: a review of a pull request, with comments on lines of its diff if given.

name: submit_pull_request_review
summary: a pending review of a pull request, submitted.

name: get_pull_request_review
summary: a review of a pull request, by id.

name: dismiss_pull_request_review
summary: a submitted review of a pull request, dismissed.

name: delete_pending_pull_request_review
summary: a pending review of a pull request, deleted; it answers the review deleted.

name: create_pull_request_review_comment
summary: a comment on a line, or a range of lines, of a pull request's diff.

name: reply_pull_request_review_comment
summary: a reply to a comment on a pull request's diff.

name: update_pull_request_review_comment
summary: a comment on a pull request's diff, its text replaced.

name: delete_pull_request_review_comment
summary: a comment on a pull request's diff, deleted.

name: get_pull_request
summary: a pull request, by number.

name: create_pull_request
summary: a new pull request, from one branch into another.

name: update_pull_request
summary: a pull request's title, text, state, base branch or whether maintainers may push to it, changed.

name: update_pull_request_branch
summary: a pull request's branch brought up to date with the latest changes of its base branch.

name: request_pull_request_reviewers
summary: a pull request's review requested from users and teams.

name: remove_pull_request_reviewers
summary: users and teams removed from those a pull request's review is requested from.

name: merge_pull_request
summary: a pull request merged into its base branch.

name: check_pull_request_merged
summary: whether a pull request has been merged.
